pr_body:
This fixes quite a few Hosting exit issues related to ConsoleLifetime.

It is probably best to review the first commit by itself - `Add NetCoreAppCurrent target to Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting`. I needed to add a `net6.0` target so I could use the new Signal APIs from #50527.

The rest of the commits fix the individual bugs.

Fix #55417
Fix #44086
Fix #50397
Fix #42224
Fix #35990

cc @stephentoub @jkotas - FYI in case you want to take a look

issue_context.title: Consume PosixSignal in Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting's ConsoleLifetime
issue_context.body:
Given that https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/50527 is done, we can finally consume it in ConsoleLifetime.

The goal is to prevent hangs and deadlocks in the most common cases:
- https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/44086
- https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/50397

This will be on .NET 6 and up only.
